description: Page through every published connector in the grokbot.tools directory, alphabetically, with the same optional filters as search_connectors. Returns compact summaries plus the total, the categories in use (first page), and a next_cursor to pass back for the next page. Use this when you want the whole directory; use search_connectors when you know what you are looking for. Read-only.

auth_type.description: 'oauth' = you sign in with your own account; 'public' = no sign-in.

category.description: Exact category name, case-insensitive, e.g. 'Developer tools & data', 'Money', 'Design', 'Docs & search', 'Projects & docs', 'Sales & support', 'Files', 'Security'. Use list_connectors with no filters to see categories in use.

cursor.description: Opaque cursor from a previous result's next_cursor. Omit for the first page.

install_method.description: How the app gets into Grok Bot: built-in plugin (Connect apps), custom MCP URL added via chat, browser only, or unverified.

limit.description: Page size, 1-50 (default 20). Larger values are clamped to 50.

query.description: Optional free-text filter on name, service, category and slug.

status.description: Grok Bot test status. 'verified' = dated test inside Grok Bot. 'seen_working' = seen working, dated re-test pending. 'unknown' = not re-tested inside Grok Bot yet (includes seen_working). 'broken' = failed when tried.

name: list_connectors
title: List Grok Bot connectors
